changes.new: Dense 4B model from SparkLLM with hybrid attention and a native 1M-token context, offering strong coding and agent performance for its size. Supports tool calls and reasoning. The Sharp-Spark version uses imatrix quantization (Q6_K_XL) and a corrected chat template.
